title: From Bias to Balance: Detecting Facial Expression Recognition Biases in Large Multimodal Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating facial expression recognition accuracy and misclassification rates across different racial demographic groups (Asian, Black, Hispanic, and White) using zero-shot prompting and linear classifiers on model embeddings, followed by statistical significance testing using two-proportion z-tests.
Analyzing and comparing emotion misclassification rates across specific gender subgroups intersecting with race (e.g., comparing error rates for Black Females versus White Females and Asian Males).
